plugins.name: Accessibility, responsive, performance, and reliability
plugins.description: WCAG scans and keyboard journeys, reduced motion, browser performance evidence, layout stability, resilient dependencies, and manual real-device acceptance gates.

auditDefinitions.title: Automated WCAG scan
auditDefinitions.userPromise: Common accessibility barriers are caught before release.
auditDefinitions.expected: Representative pages and every opened overlay have no unapproved WCAG 2.0/2.1/2.2 A/AA axe violations, and every non-allowlisted incomplete result becomes a review finding.

evidencePolicy.rationale: Capture the rendered state and structured evidence proving: Representative pages and every opened overlay have no unapproved WCAG 2.0/2.1/2.2 A/AA axe violations, and every non-allowlisted incomplete result becomes a review finding.

auditDefinitions.title: Keyboard-only journeys
auditDefinitions.userPromise: Critical tasks can be completed without a pointer.
auditDefinitions.expected: Navigation, search, calculators, disclosures, and meeting filters have logical focus order and visible focus.

evidencePolicy.rationale: Complete the critical keyboard journey and show focus, dialog, search, and Escape responses.

auditDefinitions.title: Zoom and text reflow
auditDefinitions.userPromise: Low-vision readers retain all content and controls.
auditDefinitions.expected: Critical pages work at 200% and 400% zoom without two-dimensional page scrolling.

evidencePolicy.rationale: Change browser zoom and show critical controls and content reflowing without loss.

auditDefinitions.title: Screen-reader acceptance
auditDefinitions.userPromise: Live updates and controls make sense without sight.
auditDefinitions.expected: VoiceOver announces dialogs, search results, copy feedback, scores, and live meeting changes.

evidencePolicy.rationale: Operate critical controls with a screen reader and capture their spoken state changes.

auditDefinitions.title: Reduced motion and non-color cues
auditDefinitions.userPromise: Motion-sensitive and color-impaired readers receive equivalent information.
auditDefinitions.expected: Motion is reduced and status remains understandable without relying on color.

evidencePolicy.rationale: Capture the rendered state and structured evidence proving: Motion is reduced and status remains understandable without relying on color.

auditDefinitions.title: Blocked browser storage
auditDefinitions.userPromise: Privacy settings do not make core controls unusable.
auditDefinitions.expected: Theme, sidebar, calculator, and history controls still work for the current page when storage is unavailable.

evidencePolicy.rationale: Operate theme and calculator controls with storage blocked and show current-page behavior surviving.

auditDefinitions.title: Slow and failed dependencies
auditDefinitions.userPromise: Third-party outages do not block urgent site content.
auditDefinitions.expected: Analytics, Discord, and meeting dependency failures degrade locally and visibly where needed.

evidencePolicy.rationale: Capture the rendered state and structured evidence proving: Analytics, Discord, and meeting dependency failures degrade locally and visibly where needed.

auditDefinitions.title: Page performance budgets
auditDefinitions.userPromise: Core guidance appears quickly on ordinary mobile connections.
auditDefinitions.expected: After the load event and a bounded network-quiet window, Navigation Timing, late resources, transfer budgets, and Lighthouse metrics are present and within budget.

evidencePolicy.rationale: Retain machine-readable request and assertion evidence proving: After the load event and a bounded network-quiet window, Navigation Timing, late resources, transfer budgets, and Lighthouse metrics are present and within budget.

auditDefinitions.title: Layout stability
auditDefinitions.userPromise: Late hydration does not move controls out from under the reader.
auditDefinitions.expected: Observed layout shift and post-load geometry remain within the configured budget.

evidencePolicy.rationale: Capture the rendered state and structured evidence proving: Observed layout shift and post-load geometry remain within the configured budget.

auditDefinitions.title: Real iPhone Safari acceptance
auditDefinitions.userPromise: The launch works in the browser used by many mobile readers.
auditDefinitions.expected: Critical journeys pass on current and small-screen physical iPhones.

evidencePolicy.rationale: Complete critical tap, navigation, form, and scroll journeys on physical iPhone Safari.

auditDefinitions.title: Real Android Chrome acceptance
auditDefinitions.userPromise: The launch works on representative physical Android hardware.
auditDefinitions.expected: Critical journeys pass on a current physical Pixel or Samsung device.

evidencePolicy.rationale: Complete critical tap, navigation, form, and scroll journeys on physical Android Chrome.

auditDefinitions.title: Real iPad Safari acceptance
auditDefinitions.userPromise: Tablet readers receive a deliberate layout rather than a stretched phone page.
auditDefinitions.expected: Critical journeys pass in portrait and landscape on a physical iPad.

evidencePolicy.rationale: Complete critical touch and rotation journeys on a physical iPad in both orientations.

plugins.name: Calculators and SOWS
plugins.description: Taper arithmetic, calculator persistence and export, SR-17 protocols, SOWS scoring and interpretation, and related clipboard flows.

auditDefinitions.title: Taper defaults and derived totals
auditDefinitions.userPromise: Calculator defaults produce an internally coherent plan.
auditDefinitions.expected: Defaults and total-daily math match each selected substance.

evidencePolicy.rationale: Select calculator inputs and show derived dose totals updating coherently.

auditDefinitions.title: Taper input boundaries
auditDefinitions.userPromise: Unexpected input cannot create a misleading or broken plan.
auditDefinitions.expected: Blank, decimal, minimum, maximum, and malformed input are handled visibly and safely.

evidencePolicy.rationale: Enter boundary and malformed calculator values and show visible safe handling.

auditDefinitions.title: Taper schedule generation
auditDefinitions.userPromise: A reader receives mathematically correct day-by-day output.
auditDefinitions.expected: Preset and custom schedules reach the requested jump-off with correct totals and frequency transitions.

evidencePolicy.rationale: Configure a custom taper and show the generated day-by-day schedule responding.

auditDefinitions.title: Calculator responsive output
auditDefinitions.userPromise: Charts and schedules remain readable on a phone.
auditDefinitions.expected: Chart, summary cards, tables, and touch hints render without page-level overflow.

evidencePolicy.rationale: Change calculator inputs at a mobile viewport and show responsive output remaining usable.

auditDefinitions.title: Calculator persistence and reset
auditDefinitions.userPromise: Work survives an accidental reload and can be deliberately cleared.
auditDefinitions.expected: Inputs persist per calculator, do not leak between tools, and reset to documented defaults.

evidencePolicy.rationale: Change, reload, and reset calculator inputs and show persistence followed by deliberate clearing.

auditDefinitions.title: Calculator export actions
auditDefinitions.userPromise: A plan can be copied or printed with understandable confirmation.
auditDefinitions.expected: Schedule copy, AI-prompt copy, print window, and popup-blocked fallback behave correctly.

evidencePolicy.rationale: Use calculator copy and print actions and show the exported plan and confirmations.

auditDefinitions.title: SR-17 simple protocol
auditDefinitions.userPromise: Simple mode produces the documented 7, 10, and 14-day protocols.
auditDefinitions.expected: Dose tiers, schedule phases, totals, and 50 mg tablet supply calculations are correct.

evidencePolicy.rationale: Choose SR-17 simple protocol controls and show each documented schedule being generated.

auditDefinitions.title: SR-17 advanced protocol
auditDefinitions.userPromise: Advanced controls produce a coherent cross-taper.
auditDefinitions.expected: Independent golden schedules prove allergy, preload, source reduction, hold, custom milligram, percentage, and jump-off boundaries update exact rows, duration, and supply.

evidencePolicy.rationale: Change SR-17 advanced controls and show each cross-taper phase updating.

auditDefinitions.title: Calculator arithmetic black-box coverage
auditDefinitions.userPromise: Interface evidence is backed by deterministic numeric tests.
auditDefinitions.expected: Independent rendered black-box vectors cover a published schedule, a minimum-duration boundary, an explicit-zero stop boundary, and arithmetic invariants without importing site implementation code.

evidencePolicy.rationale: Capture the rendered state and structured evidence proving: Independent rendered black-box vectors cover a published schedule, a minimum-duration boundary, an explicit-zero stop boundary, and arithmetic invariants without importing site implementation code.

auditDefinitions.title: SOWS scoring interaction
auditDefinitions.userPromise: A reader can score every withdrawal symptom accurately.
auditDefinitions.expected: All 16 items accept values zero through four and totals update after each answer.

evidencePolicy.rationale: Answer all withdrawal items and show the visible total updating after each choice.

auditDefinitions.title: SOWS interpretation
auditDefinitions.userPromise: Score guidance changes at the documented thresholds.
auditDefinitions.expected: Partial, moderate, induction-window, and high-score states display the correct interpretation.

evidencePolicy.rationale: Change SOWS answers across thresholds and show the interpretation responding.

auditDefinitions.title: SOWS logging and reset
auditDefinitions.userPromise: A reader can preserve or clear a score without ambiguity.
auditDefinitions.expected: Copy produces the visible score and timestamp; reset returns every item to zero.

evidencePolicy.rationale: Copy, collapse, reopen, and reset a SOWS score and show each state transition.

auditDefinitions.title: Quickstart disclosures and copy
auditDefinitions.userPromise: Compact setup information can be expanded and shared.
auditDefinitions.expected: Disclosure, Reddit starter copy, and clipboard feedback work with denied-clipboard fallback.

evidencePolicy.rationale: Activate the quickstart copy action and show clipboard contents and visible confirmation.

plugins.name: Meeting discovery and timing
plugins.description: Deterministic meeting states, timezone conversion, history, directory filters, join links, copy actions, and dependency failure behavior.

auditDefinitions.title: Meeting state transitions
auditDefinitions.userPromise: Live and upcoming meeting labels are time-accurate.
auditDefinitions.expected: Frozen pre-live, live, end-boundary, and no-specific-meeting states are correct.

evidencePolicy.rationale: Capture the rendered state and structured evidence proving: Frozen pre-live, live, end-boundary, and no-specific-meeting states are correct.

auditDefinitions.title: Meeting timezone conversion
auditDefinitions.userPromise: Readers see times in their own timezone.
auditDefinitions.expected: Times remain correct across US zones, Europe, India, and daylight-saving boundaries.

evidencePolicy.rationale: Capture the rendered state and structured evidence proving: Times remain correct across US zones, Europe, India, and daylight-saving boundaries.

auditDefinitions.title: Meeting history
auditDefinitions.userPromise: Recently joined rooms remain easy to find and can be removed.
auditDefinitions.expected: Join actions persist, update across pages, and support individual and full clearing.

evidencePolicy.rationale: Join a meeting, navigate to history, and clear it while showing persistence and removal.

auditDefinitions.title: NA meeting discovery
auditDefinitions.userPromise: A reader can narrow the large NA directory.
auditDefinitions.expected: A known nonempty meeting set proves search, tag, platform, and access filters each exclude incompatible records, combine to the exact destination set, and clear back to baseline.

evidencePolicy.rationale: Combine and clear NA meeting filters and show empty and restored result states.

auditDefinitions.title: SMART meeting discovery
auditDefinitions.userPromise: A reader can narrow the SMART directory.
auditDefinitions.expected: A known nonempty meeting set proves search, program, audience, and language filters each exclude incompatible records, combine to the exact destination set, and clear back to baseline.

evidencePolicy.rationale: Combine and clear SMART meeting filters and show empty and restored result states.

auditDefinitions.title: Meeting copy and join links
auditDefinitions.userPromise: Meeting details can be copied and opened accurately.
auditDefinitions.expected: Copy text, platform labels, phone links, and external join destinations match displayed details.

evidencePolicy.rationale: Activate meeting copy and join controls and show clipboard data matching the displayed destination.

auditDefinitions.title: Meeting data failure
auditDefinitions.userPromise: A temporary data problem does not create false availability.
auditDefinitions.expected: Transport aborts, HTTP errors, malformed payloads, and valid empty data settle without a spinner; failures are visibly distinct from a truthful empty result.

evidencePolicy.rationale: Capture the rendered state and structured evidence proving: Transport aborts, HTTP errors, malformed payloads, and valid empty data settle without a spinner; failures are visibly distinct from a truthful empty result.

plugins.name: Platform, routes, content, and SEO
plugins.description: Environment contracts, the complete route inventory, content semantics, metadata, redirects, visual baselines, and launch-critical home and crisis paths.

auditDefinitions.title: Environment availability
auditDefinitions.userPromise: Readers can reach the site securely.
auditDefinitions.expected: Both configured origins return usable HTML over HTTPS.

evidencePolicy.rationale: Capture the rendered state and structured evidence proving: Both configured origins return usable HTML over HTTPS.

auditDefinitions.title: Candidate route inventory
auditDefinitions.userPromise: Every published guide remains reachable.
auditDefinitions.expected: Every candidate route returns successful HTML with the expected canonical route.

evidencePolicy.rationale: Capture the rendered state and structured evidence proving: Every candidate route returns successful HTML with the expected canonical route.

auditDefinitions.title: Production-first migration ledger
auditDefinitions.userPromise: Renamed pages keep working after launch.
auditDefinitions.expected: Every route discovered in the production sitemap maps to a live candidate destination or an explicit approved removal, and every candidate-only route is approved.

evidencePolicy.rationale: Retain machine-readable request and assertion evidence proving: Every route discovered in the production sitemap maps to a live candidate destination or an explicit approved removal, and every candidate-only route is approved.

auditDefinitions.title: Redirect integrity
auditDefinitions.userPromise: Bookmarks and search results do not break.
auditDefinitions.expected: Legacy routes use a single permanent redirect without loops or chains.

evidencePolicy.rationale: Retain machine-readable request and assertion evidence proving: Legacy routes use a single permanent redirect without loops or chains.

auditDefinitions.title: Preview indexing controls
auditDefinitions.userPromise: The beta environment does not compete with production in search.
auditDefinitions.expected: Preview indexing policy is explicit and candidate canonical metadata is internally consistent.

evidencePolicy.rationale: Capture the rendered state and structured evidence proving: Preview indexing policy is explicit and candidate canonical metadata is internally consistent.

auditDefinitions.title: Security and cache headers
auditDefinitions.userPromise: Readers receive secure, correctly cached assets.
auditDefinitions.expected: Required security headers exist and immutable assets use long-lived caching.

evidencePolicy.rationale: Capture the rendered state and structured evidence proving: Required security headers exist and immutable assets use long-lived caching.

auditDefinitions.title: Custom not-found recovery
auditDefinitions.userPromise: A bad link gives the reader a useful recovery path.
auditDefinitions.expected: Unknown URLs return HTTP 404, expose the named accessible search, and let a reader reach a known recovery destination.

evidencePolicy.rationale: Open an unknown URL, use its accessible search, and activate a known recovery destination.

auditDefinitions.title: Static assets and data endpoints
auditDefinitions.userPromise: The interface loads without missing fonts, images, icons, or data.
auditDefinitions.expected: All first-party assets and JSON endpoints load with correct status and content type.

evidencePolicy.rationale: Retain machine-readable request and assertion evidence proving: All first-party assets and JSON endpoints load with correct status and content type.

auditDefinitions.title: Homepage starting paths
auditDefinitions.userPromise: A reader in distress can quickly choose the right next step.
auditDefinitions.expected: Primary calls to action and common starting points are present and navigate correctly.

evidencePolicy.rationale: Activate a primary homepage starting path and show the intended guide destination loading.

auditDefinitions.title: Support-right-now panel
auditDefinitions.userPromise: Current peer support is visible and understandable.
auditDefinitions.expected: Live, upcoming, and fallback states show accurate labels and working destinations.

evidencePolicy.rationale: Capture the rendered state and structured evidence proving: Live, upcoming, and fallback states show accurate labels and working destinations.

auditDefinitions.title: Guide directory
auditDefinitions.userPromise: Every guide category is discoverable from the homepage.
auditDefinitions.expected: Category counts and destinations agree with the published inventory.

evidencePolicy.rationale: Capture the rendered state and structured evidence proving: Category counts and destinations agree with the published inventory.

auditDefinitions.title: Community status
auditDefinitions.userPromise: Discord availability never breaks the page.
auditDefinitions.expected: Live count renders when available and fails quietly with a usable Discord link.

evidencePolicy.rationale: Capture the rendered state and structured evidence proving: Live count renders when available and fails quietly with a usable Discord link.

auditDefinitions.title: Crisis fast path
auditDefinitions.userPromise: A reader in active withdrawal receives focused immediate actions.
auditDefinitions.expected: The minimal layout excludes nonessential chrome and keeps every action visible and usable.

evidencePolicy.rationale: Capture the rendered state and structured evidence proving: The minimal layout excludes nonessential chrome and keeps every action visible and usable.

auditDefinitions.title: Urgent contact actions
auditDefinitions.userPromise: Emergency destinations can be reached without ambiguity.
auditDefinitions.expected: Discord, live meeting, 988, symptom, and full-guide actions have correct destinations.

evidencePolicy.rationale: Capture the rendered state and structured evidence proving: Discord, live meeting, 988, symptom, and full-guide actions have correct destinations.

auditDefinitions.title: Document structure
auditDefinitions.userPromise: Every guide has a coherent, navigable document outline.
auditDefinitions.expected: There is one visible H1, valid heading order, landmarks, description, and canonical metadata.

evidencePolicy.rationale: Capture the rendered state and structured evidence proving: There is one visible H1, valid heading order, landmarks, description, and canonical metadata.

auditDefinitions.title: Content rendering
auditDefinitions.userPromise: No medically important text is hidden by a layout defect.
auditDefinitions.expected: Text, lists, callouts, tables, code, blockquotes, and disclosures render without clipping.

evidencePolicy.rationale: Capture the rendered state and structured evidence proving: Text, lists, callouts, tables, code, blockquotes, and disclosures render without clipping.

auditDefinitions.title: Internal links
auditDefinitions.userPromise: Readers do not hit broken paths while seeking help.
auditDefinitions.expected: All internal links resolve and fragments identify existing targets.

evidencePolicy.rationale: Retain machine-readable request and assertion evidence proving: All internal links resolve and fragments identify existing targets.

auditDefinitions.title: External-link safety
auditDefinitions.userPromise: Third-party destinations open without exposing the source tab.
auditDefinitions.expected: External links use a new tab with noopener and noreferrer; internal links do not.

evidencePolicy.rationale: Capture the rendered state and structured evidence proving: External links use a new tab with noopener and noreferrer; internal links do not.

auditDefinitions.title: Images and diagrams
auditDefinitions.userPromise: Reference visuals remain legible and meaningful.
auditDefinitions.expected: Every declared image, picture, SVG, and CSS diagram exists in its reviewed count, loads or renders, is labeled appropriately, fits the viewport, and works in both themes.

evidencePolicy.rationale: Capture the rendered state and structured evidence proving: Every declared image, picture, SVG, and CSS diagram exists in its reviewed count, loads or renders, is labeled appropriately, fits the viewport, and works in both themes.

auditDefinitions.title: Wide reference pages
auditDefinitions.userPromise: Dense calculators and diagrams remain usable on narrow and wide screens.
auditDefinitions.expected: Wide layout, responsive grids, and intentional table scrollers behave correctly.

evidencePolicy.rationale: Capture the rendered state and structured evidence proving: Wide layout, responsive grids, and intentional table scrollers behave correctly.

auditDefinitions.title: Long-page stability
auditDefinitions.userPromise: Very long references remain responsive and navigable.
auditDefinitions.expected: The changelog and long medical guides load, scroll, and update TOC state without lockups.

evidencePolicy.rationale: Scroll progressively through long references and show that reading and navigation remain responsive.

auditDefinitions.title: Content parity ledger
auditDefinitions.userPromise: Intentional redesign edits are distinguished from accidental omissions.
auditDefinitions.expected: Critical headings, safety warnings, and CTA destinations remain present; every missing production heading must match the exact reviewed-difference ledger.

evidencePolicy.rationale: Capture the rendered state and structured evidence proving: Critical headings, safety warnings, and CTA destinations remain present; every missing production heading must match the exact reviewed-difference ledger.

auditDefinitions.title: Runtime error guard
auditDefinitions.userPromise: Pages do not silently break in a reader’s browser.
auditDefinitions.expected: No unexpected page errors, console errors, failed first-party requests, or bad first-party responses occur.

evidencePolicy.rationale: Capture the rendered state and structured evidence proving: No unexpected page errors, console errors, failed first-party requests, or bad first-party responses occur.

auditDefinitions.title: Metadata completeness
auditDefinitions.userPromise: Search and sharing previews identify every page correctly.
auditDefinitions.expected: Title, description, canonical, robots, Open Graph, and Twitter metadata are complete and valid.

evidencePolicy.rationale: Capture the rendered state and structured evidence proving: Title, description, canonical, robots, Open Graph, and Twitter metadata are complete and valid.

auditDefinitions.title: Sitemap integrity
auditDefinitions.userPromise: Search engines receive only valid canonical pages.
auditDefinitions.expected: Sitemap entries resolve, are canonical, and exclude drafts, aliases, and error pages.

evidencePolicy.rationale: Retain machine-readable request and assertion evidence proving: Sitemap entries resolve, are canonical, and exclude drafts, aliases, and error pages.

plugins.name: Shell, navigation, theme, and search
plugins.description: Responsive global chrome, keyboard and drawer navigation, reading appearance, search quality, search failure behavior, and breakpoint transitions.

auditDefinitions.title: Scheduling notice
auditDefinitions.userPromise: Readers see current scheduling information without losing access to the page.
auditDefinitions.expected: The notice renders, links correctly, dismisses, and remains dismissed after reload.

evidencePolicy.rationale: Dismiss the scheduling notice, reload, and show that the notice remains dismissed.

auditDefinitions.title: Responsive header
auditDefinitions.userPromise: Primary actions remain reachable at every supported width.
auditDefinitions.expected: Header controls follow their documented breakpoint behavior without clipping or overlap.

evidencePolicy.rationale: Capture the rendered state and structured evidence proving: Header controls follow their documented breakpoint behavior without clipping or overlap.

auditDefinitions.title: Skip link
auditDefinitions.userPromise: Keyboard users can bypass repeated navigation.
auditDefinitions.expected: The skip link becomes visible on focus and moves focus to main content.

evidencePolicy.rationale: Move keyboard focus to the skip link, activate it, and show focus reaching main content.

auditDefinitions.title: Footer navigation
auditDefinitions.userPromise: Readers can reach urgent help, site information, and community destinations.
auditDefinitions.expected: Footer links, labels, and external-link behavior are correct on mobile and desktop.

evidencePolicy.rationale: Capture the rendered state and structured evidence proving: Footer links, labels, and external-link behavior are correct on mobile and desktop.

auditDefinitions.title: Back to top
auditDefinitions.userPromise: Long articles provide a reliable escape back to the beginning.
auditDefinitions.expected: The control appears after meaningful scroll, returns to the top, and respects reduced motion.

evidencePolicy.rationale: Scroll a long page, activate Back to top, and show the viewport returning to the beginning.

auditDefinitions.title: Horizontal overflow guard
auditDefinitions.userPromise: No reader must pan sideways to read ordinary pages.
auditDefinitions.expected: Document width never exceeds viewport width except inside intentional scroll containers.

evidencePolicy.rationale: Capture the rendered state and structured evidence proving: Document width never exceeds viewport width except inside intentional scroll containers.

auditDefinitions.title: Mobile guide drawer
auditDefinitions.userPromise: Mobile readers can browse the complete guide without losing their place.
auditDefinitions.expected: Drawer opens, traps focus, closes by all expected methods, restores focus, and preserves scroll.

evidencePolicy.rationale: Open, operate, and close the mobile guide drawer while showing focus and scroll restoration.

auditDefinitions.title: Mobile category expansion
auditDefinitions.userPromise: All category pages remain discoverable on a phone.
auditDefinitions.expected: Category groups expand and collapse, current location is exposed, and links navigate correctly.

evidencePolicy.rationale: Expand and collapse mobile guide categories and show their links and current-page state responding.

auditDefinitions.title: Desktop sidebar persistence
auditDefinitions.userPromise: Desktop readers can control reading space without layout jumps.
auditDefinitions.expected: Collapse state persists and toggling does not move document scroll or focus unexpectedly.

evidencePolicy.rationale: Collapse, reload, and expand the desktop sidebar while showing persistence and stable reading position.

auditDefinitions.title: Breadcrumb navigation and sharing
auditDefinitions.userPromise: Readers know where they are and can copy a stable link.
auditDefinitions.expected: Breadcrumb links navigate and copy produces the canonical page URL with confirmation.

evidencePolicy.rationale: Activate breadcrumb sharing and show the canonical page URL copied to the clipboard.

auditDefinitions.title: Table of contents
auditDefinitions.userPromise: Readers can navigate long medical references reliably.
auditDefinitions.expected: TOC links align headings below sticky chrome and active state tracks reading position.

evidencePolicy.rationale: Activate a table-of-contents link and show hash, heading alignment, and active reading position.

auditDefinitions.title: Heading permalinks
auditDefinitions.userPromise: Readers can share a precise section.
auditDefinitions.expected: Heading links update the hash, copy the URL, and announce success without a scroll jump.

evidencePolicy.rationale: Activate a heading permalink and show its hash, clipboard confirmation, and stable scroll position.

auditDefinitions.title: Previous and next pages
auditDefinitions.userPromise: Sequential reading follows the configured guide order.
auditDefinitions.expected: Previous and next destinations match category ordering and never point to drafts.

evidencePolicy.rationale: Activate previous and next reading controls and show both intended guide destinations loading.

auditDefinitions.title: Category indexes
auditDefinitions.userPromise: Category landing pages accurately describe and enumerate their guides.
auditDefinitions.expected: Grouping, page counts, update dates, and destinations agree with the route inventory.

evidencePolicy.rationale: Capture the rendered state and structured evidence proving: Grouping, page counts, update dates, and destinations agree with the route inventory.

auditDefinitions.title: Theme selection
auditDefinitions.userPromise: Readers can choose system, light, or dark appearance.
auditDefinitions.expected: All modes apply immediately and the chosen explicit mode persists.

evidencePolicy.rationale: Choose light and dark modes and show the selected appearance applying and persisting.

auditDefinitions.title: System theme changes
auditDefinitions.userPromise: System-mode readers follow operating-system appearance changes.
auditDefinitions.expected: System mode updates live while explicit modes remain unchanged.

evidencePolicy.rationale: Choose system appearance, change the emulated system scheme, and show the page following it.

auditDefinitions.title: First-paint theme stability
auditDefinitions.userPromise: Readers do not see a flash of the wrong theme.
auditDefinitions.expected: The correct class is applied before first meaningful paint.

evidencePolicy.rationale: Capture the rendered state and structured evidence proving: The correct class is applied before first meaningful paint.

auditDefinitions.title: Breakpoint transitions
auditDefinitions.userPromise: Controls neither disappear accidentally nor collide at layout thresholds.
auditDefinitions.expected: Both sides of every custom breakpoint render without overlap, clipping, or unreachable actions.

evidencePolicy.rationale: Capture the rendered state and structured evidence proving: Both sides of every custom breakpoint render without overlap, clipping, or unreachable actions.

auditDefinitions.title: Header search dialog
auditDefinitions.userPromise: Search is immediately available from any standard page.
auditDefinitions.expected: Click and keyboard shortcut open the dialog, focus the input, and close predictably.

evidencePolicy.rationale: Open and close search with pointer and keyboard controls and show predictable focus movement.

auditDefinitions.title: Search result quality
auditDefinitions.userPromise: Queries return relevant, understandable destinations.
auditDefinitions.expected: Known terms return expected pages, highlights, categories, and excerpts.

evidencePolicy.rationale: Enter a known query and show relevant search results and excerpts responding.

auditDefinitions.title: Search keyboard navigation
auditDefinitions.userPromise: Search can be completed without a pointer.
auditDefinitions.expected: Arrow keys move through results, Enter opens the active result, and Escape behaves by context.

evidencePolicy.rationale: Use keyboard result navigation and show Enter opening the active destination.

auditDefinitions.title: Search page filters
auditDefinitions.userPromise: Readers can narrow a broad result set.
auditDefinitions.expected: Topic and result-type filters combine correctly and persist in the URL.

evidencePolicy.rationale: Apply search filters and show the result set and URL state updating together.

auditDefinitions.title: No-result guidance
auditDefinitions.userPromise: A failed query does not become a dead end.
auditDefinitions.expected: No-result copy and suggestions appear and suggested searches are usable.

evidencePolicy.rationale: Enter a query with no results and use the recovery suggestions that appear.

auditDefinitions.title: Search failure fallback
auditDefinitions.userPromise: A data-loading problem still leaves a route to content.
auditDefinitions.expected: A failed index request shows the sitemap fallback and no indefinite spinner.

evidencePolicy.rationale: Enter a search while its index request fails and show the usable sitemap fallback.
